meta.name: deck-open-slide-canvas
meta.description: 锁死 1920×1080 画布, React 组件级自由组合, 不绑模板

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定高清画布，自由组合组件制作幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在固定画布上自由设计演示内容
copy.tagline_en: Lock canvas at 1920x1080 and compose slides with React components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design presentations with free-form component layout on a fixed canvas

howto.what: 生成固定 1920×1080 画布的 HTML 幻灯片,每页内容必须完整放入画布,不允许出现滚动条;按内容自由排布,不强套模板,并自动套用所选调色板和字体。
howto.when: 当你要做幻灯片或 deck,且不想被模板束缚、需要自由排布内容时触发,例如个人作品集、设计课演示等。

say.text: 用 Sea Indigo 配色做一份设计课作品集幻灯片
做一页大字 question 布局,放一句我的选题
say.note: 按内容性质选择布局,视觉重心只有一个。

say.text: 用 Ash & Lime 调色,做三列数据对比页
say.note: 等权重网格并列,不塞两段平等文字。

howto.what_en: Generates HTML slides locked to a 1920×1080 canvas. Every slide must fit exactly with no scrollbars; layout is chosen freely so no template is forced, with a fixed palette and font set.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a slide deck that needs free-form layout and no template, e.g., a portfolio or an art/design talk.

say_en.text: Make a design-course portfolio deck in Sea Indigo colors.
say_en.note: Triggers a free-layout deck on a fixed 1920x1080 canvas.

say_en.text: Make one big-question slide with my topic text.
say_en.note: Chooses a layout fitting the content, one visual focus.

say_en.text: Use Ash & Lime for a three-column data comparison.
say_en.note: Equals-weight grid, no two equal texts side by side.
